# Brycen Wood

> Business automation consultant who builds custom operating systems for small
> businesses using Claude Code. Non-technical founder. No coding experience.
> Built 80+ automations for his own vehicle wrap company (Summit Wraps --
> $52K to $300K revenue growth, without adding a single employee). Now offers
> the same build service to other businesses. Fixed-scope: 60-min interview,
> custom plan in 72 hours, 2-week build, full handoff.

## Services
- [Custom Business Build](https://www.brycenwood.com/services/custom-build/) - Full operating system build: CRM, email, SEO, dashboards, content pipelines. Starting at $3,500.
- [Monthly AI Retainer](https://www.brycenwood.com/services/retainer/) - Ongoing support, new features, optimization. $2,000/month.
- [How It Works](https://www.brycenwood.com/process/) - 60-min interview, 72-hour plan, 2-week build, full handoff.
- [Pricing](https://www.brycenwood.com/pricing/) - Transparent pricing: $3,500 (founder), $7,500 (standard), $15,000+ (enterprise).

## FAQ
- Q: Do I need to know how to code? A: No. Every system is built through conversation with Claude Code. Zero coding experience required. Brycen himself has never written a line of code.
- Q: How long does a custom build take? A: 2 weeks from kickoff to full handoff. You receive a custom operating system blueprint within 72 hours of the discovery interview, then the full build is completed and deployed over the following 2 weeks.
- Q: What's included in the $3,500 founder rate? A: Everything -- 60-minute discovery interview, custom blueprint, full 2-week build (CRM, email, SEO, dashboards, content pipelines), handoff documentation, live training session, and 30 days of post-launch support.
- Q: Can you build for any type of business? A: Yes. Custom builds are researched and tailored for each client's specific industry. Past builds include vehicle wraps, auto tint, and systems designed for HVAC, coffee shops, steel sales, and more.
- Q: What makes this different from hiring an agency? A: Agencies charge $5K-$20K for just a website. A custom build delivers your entire operating system -- CRM, email automation, lead generation, dashboards, SEO, content pipelines -- in 2 weeks for a fraction of the cost, because AI builds at 10x the speed with 10x less overhead.
